reviewMethod: Author self-reviewed all 326 translated strings directly against their Japanese canonical source. No peer outputs were read. One Hindi sentence in session 299 was grammatically refined. Automated verification checked session IDs, full entry coverage, exact sourceJa, locales, nonempty translations, numeric sequences using [0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)*, and absence of Japanese script in translations.
limitations: No independent native-language or peer review was used. Nobiuma is transliterated as a colloquial equipment name; technical distinctions are translated in full rather than inferred as operational instructions.
